mext-undergraduate-scholarship-2028.about:
The MEXT (Monbukagakusho) Undergraduate Scholarship is Japan's flagship government award for international high-school graduates. It covers university tuition and entrance fees, a monthly stipend (about JPY 117,000 in recent cycles) and a return economy ticket, for a one-year Japanese-language preparatory course followed by a four-year bachelor's (six years for medicine, dentistry, veterinary or pharmacy). Students study in Japanese at national universities.

Application is through the Japanese embassy or consulate in your country (embassy recommendation): first screening with written exams in maths, sciences or social studies, English and Japanese, plus an interview; MEXT then places successful candidates at universities from November with results early the following year. Applicants must be roughly 17-25 years old and have completed 12 years of school. Most embassies, including those covering Georgia and Qatar, open the call in April-May.
highlights: Apply via your local Japanese embassy
mext-undergraduate-scholarship-2028.eligibility: Nationals of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan, about 17-25 years old, who have completed (or will complete) 12 years of school. Must be willing to learn Japanese and study in Japanese. Each embassy may add rules.
how_to_apply: Check the Japanese embassy website for your country from April 2027
Submit the application form, transcripts and certificates by the embassy deadline
Sit the embassy written exams and interview
If recommended, MEXT places you at a university; results early 2028
mext-undergraduate-scholarship-2028.costs: Tuition and fees waived, monthly stipend (~JPY 117,000), return airfare; about 5 years (7 for medicine-type fields).

miami-stamps-singer-premier-scholarships.about:
The University of Miami's Premier Scholarships are its top merit awards. Two of them are open to all incoming first-year students regardless of citizenship: the Stamps Scholarship (full cost of attendance plus a US$12,000 enrichment fund for study abroad, research or internships) and the Isaac Bashevis Singer Scholarship (full tuition). Other Premier awards are restricted to US citizens.

To be considered you must submit your Common App by the Early Action or Early Decision I deadline of 1 Nov 2026. All first-year applicants are also automatically considered for the President's Scholarship (up to US$30,000 a year) and Canes Achievement Award (up to US$20,000).
highlights: Stamps: full cost of attendance + US$12,000 enrichment fund
miami-stamps-singer-premier-scholarships.eligibility: All incoming first-year students, including international students, who apply EA or ED I.
how_to_apply: Submit the Common App by 1 Nov 2026 (Early Action or Early Decision I)
Finalists are invited for further review in early 2027
International applicants also submit financial documentation for the I-20
miami-stamps-singer-premier-scholarships.costs: Stamps: full cost of attendance plus US$12,000; Singer: full tuition (about US$60,000+ a year).

middlebury-international-aid-2027.about:
Middlebury College in Vermont is a top liberal arts college famous for languages, international studies and environmental studies. It offers need-based financial aid to international students, with no merit scholarships; admission is need-aware for international aid applicants.

Apply Early Decision I (2 Nov), Early Decision II (4 Jan) or Regular Decision (5 Jan) via the Common App or Coalition, indicate you are applying for aid and submit the CSS Profile and documents on the Financial Aid page. Decisions arrive in late March.
middlebury-international-aid-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years who request aid at admission.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App or Coalition by 5 Jan 2027
Indicate you are applying for financial aid
Submit the CSS Profile and financial documents
Decisions in late March
middlebury-international-aid-2027.costs: Need-based grants toward cost of attendance.

modul-university-vienna-20th-anniversary.about:
Modul University Vienna is a private, English-taught university specialising in tourism and hospitality, business, sustainability and new media. For its 20th anniversary it is awarding 20 scholarships to new students starting any bachelor's or MSc programme in 2027/28. Awards cover 40%, 60% or 80% of tuition (remaining undergraduate tuition €5,400, €3,600 or €1,800 per year).

Selection is holistic: academic potential (and keeping an 80% GPA), financial need, motivation and extracurricular involvement. Shortlisted candidates have an online interview with an admissions coordinator and two scholarship committee members. Open to all nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.
modul-university-vienna-20th-anniversary.eligibility: New applicants for 2027/28 to any MU bachelor's or MSc programme who meet academic requirements and show financial need, academic potential, motivation and extracurricular involvement.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to an MU bachelor's programme for 2027/28.
Submit the scholarship application documents described in the official call.
Attend an online interview with the admissions and scholarship committee if invited.
Keep a minimum 80% GPA to retain the award.
modul-university-vienna-20th-anniversary.costs: Tuition reduction of 40%, 60% or 80%; remaining undergraduate tuition €5,400 / €3,600 / €1,800 per year.

moe-taiwan-scholarship-graduate-2027.about:
The Taiwan Scholarship, funded by Taiwan's Ministry of Education (MOE), supports international students on full degree programmes at Taiwanese universities such as National Taiwan University, National Tsing Hua, National Cheng Kung and National Yang Ming Chiao Tung. Graduate awards last up to two years for a master's and four years for a PhD.

The scholarship pays tuition and miscellaneous fees up to a set cap per semester and a monthly living stipend, with a higher stipend for graduate students than undergraduates. Applicants must apply separately for admission to their chosen Taiwanese university; many programmes are taught in English.

Applications are submitted to the Taiwan embassy or Taipei representative office responsible for your country, generally between February and April (the 2026 guidelines set 31 March as the postmark deadline). Check your local office's 2027 announcement for exact dates and documents.
highlights: Tuition plus monthly stipend for the whole degree
Combine with university admission to NTU, NTHU, NCKU and more
moe-taiwan-scholarship-graduate-2027.eligibility: Foreign nationals with good academic records from countries where Taiwan has a representative office, not holding Taiwanese nationality or overseas Chinese status, not previously holding a Taiwan Scholarship for the same level. Georgian and Qatari citizens apply via the competent Taiwan office for their region.
how_to_apply: Find the Taiwan office responsible for your country and its 2027 call
Apply for admission to up to three Taiwanese universities
Submit the scholarship application form, transcripts, study plan, two recommendations and language proof to the office by its deadline
Results around May; submit university admission letter to confirm
moe-taiwan-scholarship-graduate-2027.costs: Tuition and fees up to the MOE cap per semester plus a monthly stipend (graduate rate higher than undergraduate). Airfare and insurance at own cost.

mofa-taiwan-fellowship-2028.about:
The MOFA Taiwan Fellowship, run by Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs with the National Central Library, invites foreign experts, scholars and doctoral students to conduct advanced research at universities or academic institutions in Taiwan. Topics include Taiwan studies, cross-strait relations, the Asia-Pacific region and Sinology, plus policy themes such as energy security, undersea cables and supply-chain resilience.

Doctoral candidates, doctoral programme students, postdocs and assistant professors receive NT$50,000 per month (professors NT$60,000), plus one round-trip economy ticket. Applications open every year in May and June, and fellows start their research from January of the following year.
highlights: Host institution of your choice in Taiwan
mofa-taiwan-fellowship-2028.eligibility: Foreign scholars and doctoral candidates/students (non-ROC nationals) with research topics related to Taiwan, cross-strait relations, Asia-Pacific or Sinology; host institution in Taiwan required.
how_to_apply: Find a host institution and academic contact in Taiwan
Prepare a research proposal, CV and recommendation letters
Apply online on the Taiwan Fellowship website between 1 May and 30 June 2027
Results announced later in the year; research starts from January 2028
mofa-taiwan-fellowship-2028.costs: NT$50,000 monthly (NT$60,000 for professors) plus one round-trip economy airfare.

mount-holyoke-international-aid-merit-20.about:
Mount Holyoke College is a women's liberal arts college in Massachusetts and part of the Five College Consortium, with one of the largest international communities of any US college. 45% of incoming international students receive need-based aid (average US$58,686) or merit scholarships (average US$17,500).

All applicants are automatically considered for merit aid. For need-based aid, submit the international CSS Profile and a parental tax return or income verification; non-aid applicants submit the International Financial Declaration. Test-optional, with English proficiency required for non-native speakers.
mount-holyoke-international-aid-merit-20.eligibility: Women (and gender-diverse applicants per college policy) of any nationality applying as first-years.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App or Coalition (RD typically 15 Jan 2027)
For aid: submit the CSS Profile and parental income documents
Merit is considered automatically
Send the midyear report by 15 Feb
mount-holyoke-international-aid-merit-20.costs: Need-based grants and merit scholarships toward cost of attendance (~US$85,000).

nawa-banach-scholarship-2027.about:
The Banach NAWA programme offers scholarships for full-time second-cycle (master's) studies taught in Polish or English at universities supervised by Poland's Minister of Science and Higher Education. Its goal is to support the socio-economic development of developing countries by raising the education and professional qualifications of their citizens.

It is open to citizens of the 36 countries covered by Polish Aid in Eastern Europe, Asia, Africa and Latin America (Georgia is one of Polish Aid's long-standing Eastern Partnership priority countries; check the country list in the call). The 2026 call (16/2026) was published on 13 April 2026 with lists of eligible universities and accepted Polish/English certificates. Scholars receive a monthly stipend and tuition-free study at the host university.
highlights: Full master's in Poland, tuition-free with a monthly stipend
Polish- or English-taught programmes at public universities
Development-aid programme for Eastern Partnership and other Polish Aid countries
nawa-banach-scholarship-2027.eligibility: Citizens of the Polish Aid countries listed in the call (Eastern Partnership countries such as Georgia are typically included), holding a bachelor's degree, applying to a master's at an eligible Polish university, with proof of Polish or English proficiency from the accepted certificate list.
how_to_apply: Check NAWA's Banach page in spring 2027 for the call and country list.
Choose a master's programme at a university on the call's list (Polish- or English-taught).
Prepare diploma, transcripts, language certificate and motivation materials.
Submit the application in NAWA's online system before the deadline; await results and university admission.
nawa-banach-scholarship-2027.costs: Monthly stipend and tuition-free study under NAWA's regulations for natural persons (amounts set in the call).

nazarbayev-university-abai-scholarship-i.about:
Nazarbayev University in Astana, Kazakhstan, is an English-medium research university built with partners such as Cambridge, Duke, Penn and NUS. International undergraduates can receive the Abai Kunanbayev Scholarship, a merit award recommended by each school's admissions committee that covers tuition, medical insurance and a monthly stipend. International Olympiad medallists (last three years) can also get 25% tuition coverage.

Apply online at admissions.nu.edu.kz with transcripts, recommendation letters, English proficiency proof and passport; schools shortlist candidates for a video or in-person interview, and offers appear in your applicant account.
nazarbayev-university-abai-scholarship-i.eligibility: Top international (non-Kazakhstan) applicants to NU bachelor's programmes, as judged by the admissions committee.
how_to_apply: Apply online at admissions.nu.edu.kz when the 2027 cycle opens
Upload transcripts, recommendations, English test and passport
Attend the interview if shortlisted
Scholarship decided with admission
nazarbayev-university-abai-scholarship-i.costs: Tuition (US$15,000/yr), medical insurance and monthly stipend.

newcastle-vc-excellence-undergraduate-sc.about:
The Vice-Chancellor's Excellence Scholarships reward outstanding international undergraduates with up to 50% off tuition fees for the full length of their degree, starting September 2027 at Newcastle's city-centre campus.

There is no country restriction: any applicant assessed as international for fees can apply, including students from Georgia and Qatar. You need (or expect) at least ABB at A level or equivalent, an offer for an eligible programme, and a separate scholarship application in the Apply to Newcastle Portal. Selection weighs academic ability, commitment to study and the quality of the application.
highlights: Up to 50% off tuition for the whole degree
Open to every nationality paying international fees
newcastle-vc-excellence-undergraduate-sc.eligibility: International-fee applicants of any nationality with an offer for an eligible 2027/28 undergraduate programme and at least ABB at A level (or equivalent). Must apply via UCAS by 13 Jan 2027 and firm/insure Newcastle by 3 May 2027 if offered by 31 Mar.
how_to_apply: Apply to your course via UCAS by 13 January 2027.
After receiving your offer, log in to the Apply to Newcastle Portal.
Complete the form under 'scholarship applications' before 2 April 2027.
Accept Newcastle as Firm or Insurance choice by 3 May 2027.
newcastle-vc-excellence-undergraduate-sc.costs: Up to 50% tuition fee reduction every year of the degree.

newcastle-vc-international-academic-meri.about:
The University of Newcastle in New South Wales awards the Vice-Chancellor's International Academic Merit Scholarship: 30% of the gross annual international tuition fee for the duration of the degree, with up to 270 scholarships in 2027. Undergraduates need a minimum selection rank of 85 or international equivalent.

Newcastle also gives a 20% International Excellence Scholarship automatically to applicants who receive an offer to an eligible programme starting in Trimester 1, 2027 or later, and a 25% Excelencia Internacional Scholarship for applicants from South and Central America.
highlights: 30% of tuition for the full degree
newcastle-vc-international-academic-meri.eligibility: International students commencing an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree in 2027 with selection rank 85+ (or equivalent).
how_to_apply: Apply to an eligible University of Newcastle programme
Apply for the VC International Academic Merit Scholarship as directed on its page
Accept your offer and scholarship by the deadline
newcastle-vc-international-academic-meri.costs: 30% of gross annual tuition (international tuition roughly A$35,000-45,000/year).

newcastle-vc-international-undergraduate.about:
Newcastle University (Russell Group) offers partial Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships worth £7,000 per year for the full duration of an undergraduate degree starting in September 2027 at the Newcastle city-centre campus.

Applicants must be domiciled in one of the listed countries/regions (including Algeria, Bahrain, Bangladesh, Brazil, Canada, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Japan, Jordan, Kenya, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Norway, Pakistan, Singapore, South Africa, Switzerland, Türkiye, UAE, Ukraine, USA, Vietnam, all EU member states and others). Georgia and Qatar are not on the published list. Candidates are judged on their academic application; a list of excluded courses is in the 2027-28 terms PDF.
highlights: No separate form: assessed with your UCAS application
Open to all EU states and ~35 other countries
newcastle-vc-international-undergraduate.eligibility: International-fee applicants domiciled in an eligible country/region (see page; Georgia and Qatar not listed) with an offer for an eligible 2027/28 undergraduate course at the Newcastle campus. Türkiye-domiciled applicants must be self-funded.
how_to_apply: Apply via UCAS by the equal-consideration deadline of 13 January 2027.
If you receive an offer by 31 March 2027, accept Newcastle as Firm or Insurance choice by 3 May 2027.
Eligible candidates are assessed automatically; awards are made through the year.
newcastle-vc-international-undergraduate.costs: £7,000 tuition fee reduction each year of the degree. Living costs not covered.

nju-chinese-government-scholarship-type-.about:
Nanjing University's 2027 Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) High-Level Postgraduate Program lets the university recruit outstanding international master's and doctoral students directly. The package includes tuition exemption, accommodation, a monthly stipend of RMB 3,000 (master's) or RMB 3,500 (PhD) and RMB 800 a year for health insurance.

English-taught programmes require IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 85 or Duolingo 100; Chinese-taught ones require HSK. Students holding any other Chinese scholarship for 2027-28 are ineligible. Register and apply on NJU's China International Student Service System between 1 November 2026 and 20 January 2027 (programme type 'CSC Scholarship Type B'); those pre-admitted then file on the CSC website before 17 March 2027.
nju-chinese-government-scholarship-type-.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens (all nationalities incl. Georgia and Qatar); bachelor's for master's, master's (under 40) for PhD; graduates of 2027 may apply with a pre-graduation certificate; English or HSK requirements per programme.
how_to_apply: Register on NJU's China International Student Service System (nju.17gz.org)
Choose 'CSC Scholarship Type B' and upload passport, degrees, transcripts, study plan, references and language results
Submit between 1 Nov 2026 and 20 Jan 2027
If pre-admitted, apply on the CSC portal before 17 Mar 2027
nju-chinese-government-scholarship-type-.costs: Tuition waived, free campus accommodation (or subsidy), monthly stipend CNY 3,000 (master's) / CNY 3,500 (PhD), comprehensive medical insurance (CNY 800/year).

nl-scholarship-bachelor-2027.about:
The NL Scholarship (until recently called the Holland Scholarship) is funded by the Dutch Ministry of Education together with Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences. It is a one-off €5,000 grant in the first year of study, not a full-tuition award.

It is for non-EEA nationals (so students from Georgia, Qatar and most of the world qualify) applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating institution, who have no previous Dutch degree. Participants in 2026-27 included Maastricht, Groningen, Radboud, Twente, Utrecht, VU Amsterdam, TU/e, Wageningen and many universities of applied sciences. Each institution sets its own deadline and eligible programmes.
nl-scholarship-bachelor-2027.eligibility: Non-EEA nationals applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating Dutch institution, meeting its specific requirements, with no previous degree from a Dutch institution.
how_to_apply: Check the participating institutions list on Study in NL.
Apply for your bachelor's programme (usually via Studielink and the university).
Find the NL Scholarship page of that institution and submit its scholarship application by its deadline (often 1 February or 1 May).
Receive the €5,000 in your first year if selected.
nl-scholarship-bachelor-2027.costs: €5,000 one-off in the first year; tuition for non-EEA bachelor's students is usually €9,000–€20,000+ a year.

nl-scholarship-masters-2027.about:
The NL Scholarship (previously the Holland Scholarship) is funded by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science together with participating Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences. It gives €5,000 in the first year of a full-time bachelor's or master's to international students from outside the European Economic Area.

Participating research universities include TU Eindhoven, Maastricht, Radboud, Groningen, Twente, Utrecht-area institutions, VU Amsterdam and Wageningen, plus more than 20 universities of applied sciences and arts schools. It is not a full scholarship, but it noticeably reduces first-year costs and can sometimes be combined with other awards.

You apply directly to the institution where you are applying for your master's, usually through its scholarship page, by the institution's own deadline.
nl-scholarship-masters-2027.eligibility: Non-EEA nationals (incl. Georgia and Qatar) who meet the entry requirements of a participating Dutch institution and have not previously studied at a Dutch institution.
how_to_apply: Check the list of participating institutions on studyinnl.org
Apply for admission to a full-time master's
Submit the NL Scholarship application on the institution's scholarship page by its deadline (often 1 Feb or 1 May)
Receive the decision from the institution
nl-scholarship-masters-2027.costs: €5,000 one-off payment in the first year. Not a full-tuition scholarship.

notre-dame-financial-aid-international-2.about:
The University of Notre Dame in Indiana is one of the few US universities whose international undergraduate admission is need-blind: applicants are evaluated without regard to their ability to pay. Admitted students who apply for aid receive need-based packages made of University scholarships and student employment.

Apply Restrictive Early Action by 1 Nov 2026 or Regular Decision by 1 Jan 2027, then submit the 2027-28 CSS Profile (code 1841) by 15 Nov 2026 or 15 Jan 2027, plus tax or earnings documents through IDOC.
notre-dame-financial-aid-international-2.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-year undergraduates.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by 1 Jan 2027 (RD) or 1 Nov 2026 (REA)
Submit the CSS Profile (code 1841) by 15 Jan 2027
Upload parent tax returns or non-filer statement and earnings statements via IDOC
notre-dame-financial-aid-international-2.costs: Need-based University scholarships and student employment toward tuition, room and board (cost of attendance about US$90,000/year).

ntu-singapore-undergraduate-scholarships.about:
Nanyang Technological University in Singapore offers merit-based, need-based and talent-based undergraduate scholarships; its scholarship finder lists about 170 awards with an 'International Student' filter for freshmen, covering programmes from engineering and computing to business, medicine and humanities. NTU also nominates ASEAN nationals for the ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship.

The scholarship application follows the admission timeline and must be submitted before you receive your admission outcome. For IB holders, apply online between 15 Oct 2026 and 19 Mar 2027, then submit the photograph and appraisal form by 26 Mar 2027; outcomes come March-May 2027.
highlights: About 170 scholarships, many open to internationals
ntu-singapore-undergraduate-scholarships.eligibility: International freshmen applying for NTU undergraduate admission in AY2027; each scholarship sets its own nationality and academic criteria.
how_to_apply: Apply for NTU admission in your qualification's window (IB: by 19 Mar 2027)
Submit the scholarship application online before your admission outcome
Upload photo and appraisal form by 26 Mar 2027
Attend interviews if shortlisted
ntu-singapore-undergraduate-scholarships.costs: Varies by scholarship, up to full tuition (after Tuition Grant) plus living allowance.

ntu-taiwan-scholarships-international-de.about:
National Taiwan University in Taipei offers scholarships for international degree students at bachelor's and graduate level. Some can be applied for along with your admission application; others come from the Taiwan government (such as the Taiwan Scholarship via embassies/representative offices) and individual colleges. An admission offer does not guarantee a scholarship.

For September 2027 entry, the second application round is open from 1 Dec 2026 to 19 Jan 2027. Many programmes are taught in Mandarin, with a growing number in English.
ntu-taiwan-scholarships-international-de.eligibility: International (foreign national) applicants for NTU bachelor's degrees in the September 2027 intake.
how_to_apply: Apply online in the second round (1 Dec 2026 - 19 Jan 2027)
Tick/complete the scholarship section in your application
Check Taiwan government scholarships via your local Taiwan office
ntu-taiwan-scholarships-international-de.costs: Varies: tuition waivers and/or monthly stipends depending on the award.

nycu-international-degree-scholarships-2.about:
National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, formed from National Chiao Tung and National Yang-Ming universities, is Taiwan's leading university for electronics, semiconductors, computer science and biomedicine, located next to Hsinchu Science Park. New international degree students are considered for NYCU international student scholarships, with results announced together with admission (mid-May 2027); award listings include full tuition waivers.

Apply online between 20 Dec 2026 and 15 Mar 2027; late or incomplete applications are not considered. Classes start in early September 2027.
nycu-international-degree-scholarships-2.eligibility: International degree applicants for Fall 2027 (bachelor's and graduate).
how_to_apply: Prepare transcripts, study plan and recommendation letters
Apply online between 20 Dec 2026 and 15 Mar 2027
Results incl. scholarships in mid-May 2027; reply by late May
nycu-international-degree-scholarships-2.costs: Up to full tuition waiver depending on the award.

oamk-bachelor-early-bird-finnish-languag.about:
Oamk in Oulu, northern Finland, charges non-EU/EEA students about €10,000 a year for English-taught bachelor's programmes. Every newly selected fee-paying student gets a €2,000 Early Bird discount on first-year tuition if they confirm their study place within 7 days of the admission result.

During the degree Oamk also awards scholarships based solely on Finnish-language skills, up to €6,000 over the normal study time. Students from Georgia, Qatar and all non-EU countries can apply.
highlights: Up to €6,000 more for learning Finnish
oamk-bachelor-early-bird-finnish-languag.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA students selected for an English-taught Oamk bachelor's programme. Early Bird not available to transfer, double/joint-degree or Open UAS-route students.
how_to_apply: Apply in Finland's joint application for English-taught bachelor's programmes on Studyinfo.fi (usually early-to-mid January; check the 2027 dates).
Accept your study place within 7 days of the result to get the Early Bird discount.
Pay the reduced first-year fee.
Study Finnish to qualify for later language scholarships.
oamk-bachelor-early-bird-finnish-languag.costs: Tuition about €10,000/year; €2,000 Early Bird reduction in year 1; Finnish-language scholarships up to €6,000 in total.

oberlin-international-aid-2027.about:
Oberlin College in Ohio combines a liberal arts college with one of the best-known conservatories of music in the US. It states that it meets 100% of demonstrated financial need, and lists dedicated scholarships for international students.

Apply via the Common App to the College of Arts and Sciences or the Conservatory (or both, as a double-degree), request aid and submit the financial documents listed on Oberlin's international aid pages.
highlights: Top conservatory of music plus liberal arts
oberlin-international-aid-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years to the College or Conservatory; request aid at admission.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by the RD deadline (typically 15 Jan; Conservatory earlier)
Request financial aid in your application
Submit the CSS Profile or forms listed on Oberlin's international aid page
Conservatory applicants complete prescreening and auditions
oberlin-international-aid-2027.costs: Need-based grants and work meeting full demonstrated need.

occidental-international-merit-scholarsh.about:
Occidental College is a liberal arts college in Los Angeles, known for politics, diplomacy and world affairs and its UN programme. All international applicants are automatically considered for merit scholarships recognising academic and personal achievement; no separate application is needed.

Need-based aid for international students is extremely limited and goes to a small number each year; applicants with need must submit the required forms by the application deadline (ED I/EA 1 Nov, ED II/RD 10 Jan).
highlights: Automatic merit consideration for all internationals
Diplomacy & World Affairs in Los Angeles
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by 10 Jan 2027 (RD)
Merit is considered automatically
If you need aid, submit the international aid forms by the same deadline
occidental-international-merit-scholarsh.costs: Merit scholarships of varying amounts toward tuition (~US$65,000/year).

otago-international-academic-excellence-.about:
The University of Otago in Dunedin is New Zealand's oldest university, known for health sciences, sciences and a lively student city. Its International Academic Excellence Scholarship, worth about NZ$35,000 in total, covers first-year accommodation in a residential college plus tuition scholarships in years two and three.

It is for high-achieving international students who studied overseas and will start a full-time bachelor's degree at Otago. Apply for admission and then complete the scholarship application by the published closing date.
otago-international-academic-excellence-.eligibility: High-achieving international students who studied overseas and commence a full-time Otago bachelor's degree.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to an Otago bachelor's programme
Complete the International Academic Excellence Scholarship application
Submit academic transcripts and any supporting statements by the closing date
otago-international-academic-excellence-.costs: First-year accommodation plus tuition scholarships (total ~NZ$35,000); international tuition roughly NZ$35,000-45,000/year.

ozyegin-university-international-scholar.about:
Özyeğin University is a private, English-medium research university on the Asian side of Istanbul, known for engineering, business, economics, law, architecture, hospitality and aviation. For 2026-27 the standard international tuition is about US$25,000 per year, but scholarships are available to successful applicants based on their academic profile.

All applicants are automatically evaluated for scholarships, with sample awards of 40%, 50% and 60% published by the university; no separate scholarship application is needed. Scholarships do not apply to the Professional Flight programme.
highlights: Strong engineering, business and international relations programmes
ozyegin-university-international-scholar.eligibility: International applicants to Özyeğin bachelor's programmes (including citizens of Georgia and the Gulf states) meeting admission criteria; award level depends on academic results.
how_to_apply: Apply online through Özyeğin's international admissions portal.
Upload transcripts, diploma/predicted grades, passport and test scores (SAT/IB/A-levels or national exam results as accepted).
Receive your admission decision with the scholarship rate.
Confirm your place by paying the deposit.
ozyegin-university-international-scholar.costs: 40%, 50% or 60% off tuition (standard rate about US$25,000/year); not applicable to Professional Flight.

paris-saclay-international-masters-schol.about:
Université Paris-Saclay's International Master's Scholarship Program (funded by its IDEX excellence initiative) supports excellent foreign students in any master's programme run by Paris-Saclay or its member schools (AgroParisTech, CentraleSupélec, ENS Paris-Saclay, IOGS, UVSQ, Évry and others). The award is €10,000 per academic year, paid monthly September–June, plus a flat travel/visa allowance of up to €900; it renews automatically for M2 if you progress.

You cannot apply directly. First apply for an M1 or M2 programme before the scholarship deadline; course coordinators then nominate admitted candidates, who receive a link to the scholarship form and add two references. Applicants must be under 30, enrolling in France for the first time, and not hold other funding above €600/month (incompatible with Eiffel and Erasmus Mundus).
paris-saclay-international-masters-schol.eligibility: Foreign nationals (incl. Georgia and Qatar) under 30, admitted to a Paris-Saclay master's, never previously enrolled in French higher education (exchange excepted), without other funding over €600/month.
how_to_apply: Apply early to a Paris-Saclay master's (M1 or M2)
Get admitted and selected by the course coordinator
Complete the online scholarship form and have two referees submit recommendations by the deadline (end of March in 2026)
Results in mid-May
paris-saclay-international-masters-schol.costs: €10,000 per year (paid monthly) + up to €900 yearly travel/visa allowance. Tuition (French public fees) not covered.

plymouth-international-undergraduate-wel.about:
The International Undergraduate Welcome to Plymouth Scholarship is offered automatically to any international student who meets the entry requirements for their course. For 2026/27 starters it was £4,000 off first-year fees, then £1,000 off in the second year and £1,000 in the final year (up to £6,000).

Plymouth is a coastal university known for marine science, nursing, medicine-related and engineering courses. All nationalities qualify.
highlights: Automatic if you meet entry requirements
plymouth-international-undergraduate-wel.eligibility: International-fee undergraduate students who meet the entry requirements of their course.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Meet the entry requirements in your offer.
The scholarship is applied automatically to your tuition fees.
plymouth-international-undergraduate-wel.costs: Fee reduction: £4,000 (year 1), £1,000 (year 2), £1,000 (final year), based on 2026/27 terms.

polimi-merit-based-international-scholar.about:
Politecnico di Milano, Italy's leading engineering, architecture and design university, runs an annual Merit-Based International Scholarships call. For 2027-28 it offers 10 Platinum and 18 Gold scholarships for English-taught MSc programmes on the Milano Leonardo and Bovisa campuses, 16 Gold and 10 Bronze scholarships for specific Piacenza programmes, and 10 Silver scholarships (tuition waiver) for Cremona, Lecco, Mantova and Piacenza campuses. All include a tuition fee waiver; Platinum and Gold also include a cash amount set out in the call.

Only international students who submitted their MSc admission application and paid the fee between 1 October and 1 December 2026 may apply. The scholarship form is submitted through Polimi Online Services by noon on 15 December 2026; results come three to four months later. The commission considers merit, geographic origin and age, and gives priority to candidates from countries affected by war.
highlights: Tuition waiver plus cash award for top tiers
Engineering, architecture and design at a top-20 QS subject school
polimi-merit-based-international-scholar.eligibility: International students (all nationalities incl. Georgia and Qatar) applying to the first year of an English-taught MSc at Politecnico di Milano for 2027-28 who paid the application fee by 1 December 2026.
how_to_apply: Submit your MSc admission application and pay the fee by 1 December 2026
Log in to Polimi Online Services > Benefits and Agreements > Economic benefits > Scholarships for International MSc Students 2027-28
Submit the scholarship form by 12:00 noon on 15 December 2026
Accept by paying the administrative fee if awarded
polimi-merit-based-international-scholar.costs: Tuition fee waiver for the year; Platinum and Gold add a cash award (amounts in the call). Administrative fee and insurance payable.

politecnico-di-milano-dsu-scholarship-ba.about:
Diritto allo Studio Universitario (DSU) is Italy's right-to-study system. Every June, Politecnico di Milano publishes a call for DSU benefits: a scholarship made of money and services (notably canteen meals), with higher amounts for students living away from home, plus possible accommodation. International students, including non-EU students, are eligible.

You must obtain an ISEE 'for university use' (for foreign income, a parificato ISEE built from family documents from your home country) below the call's limit. First-year students qualify on income; later years also require a minimum number of credits. You can submit before enrolling, even before taking the admission test.
politecnico-di-milano-dsu-scholarship-ba.eligibility: Students enrolling in a PoliMi Bachelor of Science (any nationality) whose family ISEE for university use is within the call's limit; renewal requires minimum credits.
how_to_apply: Get admitted to (or apply for) a PoliMi Bachelor of Science (English- or Italian-taught).
Collect family income and asset documents from your home country (legalised/translated) for the ISEE parificato.
Request the ISEE 'for university use' within the call's deadlines.
Submit the DSU form in PoliMi Online Services > Benefits and agreements > DSU Benefits.
politecnico-di-milano-dsu-scholarship-ba.costs: Scholarship (money + free/discounted meals), higher for students living away from home; may include accommodation and tuition exemption under the call's rules.

polyu-cultural-ambassador-scholarship-no.about:
The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, strong in engineering, design, hotel and tourism management, business and health sciences, offers the Cultural Ambassador Scholarship for Non-Local Students: renewable, up to HK$60,000 a year, for non-local students with international qualifications. No application is required; eligible students are considered automatically. PolyU lists 26 scholarships in total, and students may hold several up to annual tuition plus HK$60,000.

Apply through PolyU's international/other qualifications route; Sept 2027 programmes show an early-round deadline of 17 Nov 2026, with main and extended rounds after that.
highlights: Up to HK$60,000 a year, renewable
polyu-cultural-ambassador-scholarship-no.eligibility: Non-local students holding international qualifications admitted to PolyU undergraduate programmes.
how_to_apply: Choose your Sept 2027 programme and apply online via the international qualifications route
Submit by 17 Nov 2026 (early round) or later main round
Scholarship decided automatically with admission
polyu-cultural-ambassador-scholarship-no.costs: Up to HK$60,000 a year against non-local tuition of roughly HK$190,000-200,000.

polyu-presidential-phd-fellowship-2027.about:
The PolyU Presidential PhD Fellowship Scheme (PPPFS) is The Hong Kong Polytechnic University's own elite fellowship for outstanding PhD candidates, run alongside the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS). For the whole normal study period, fellows receive an annual stipend of HK$340,800, a conference grant of HK$25,000, a Research Excellence Scholarship as a full tuition fee waiver, a cash award (HK$40,000 in year one, HK$20,000 a year afterwards) and an eligible hall place for one year.

Selection is very competitive: applicants must meet PolyU's PhD entry and English requirements and show exceptional academic achievement, quality international publications, outstanding references and leadership. Anyone applying to PolyU through HKPFS is automatically considered for PPPFS, the Kuok Group Fellowship and the International PhD Fellowship Scheme.
polyu-presidential-phd-fellowship-2027.eligibility: Applicants of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) to PolyU PhD programmes who apply through the HKPFS and show exceptional research potential.
how_to_apply: Register on the RGC HKPFS portal and obtain a reference number
Apply to a PolyU PhD programme quoting your HKPFS number by the deadline
Upload research proposal, publications, CV and references
Shortlisted candidates are interviewed; PPPFS is considered automatically
polyu-presidential-phd-fellowship-2027.costs: HK$340,800/year stipend, full tuition waiver, HK$25,000 conference grant, cash award HK$40,000 (year 1) + HK$20,000/year, 1 year of hall housing.

pomona-financial-aid-international-2027.about:
Pomona College in southern California, part of the Claremont Colleges consortium, meets the full demonstrated need of every admitted international student. Loans are not used: aid comes as grants and campus work. About 41% of international students receive aid, averaging nearly US$74,000 a year.

There are no merit or athletic scholarships, so need-based aid is the only funding. Admission is need-aware for international applicants.

Apply Early Decision I, Early Decision II or Regular Decision via the Common App or QuestBridge, request aid, and submit the CSS Profile and financial documents.
highlights: Full need met for every admitted international student
Access to classes across the five Claremont Colleges
pomona-financial-aid-international-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years who are not currently enrolled full time at another college. Need-aware admission.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App (ED I, ED II or RD)
Indicate that you are applying for financial aid
Submit the CSS Profile and requested financial documents
Receive your aid offer with your admission decision
pomona-financial-aid-international-2027.costs: Grants and campus work covering the full cost of attendance minus family contribution.

qmul-global-excellence-scholarship-pgt-2.about:
Queen Mary University of London, a Russell Group university in east London, offers Global Excellence Scholarships of £8,000 to outstanding international offer holders on eligible postgraduate taught programmes starting September 2027. The number of awards is unlimited until April 2027 and scholarships are allocated on a rolling basis.

You need an offer for an eligible PGT programme and a minimum first-class degree (or the overseas equivalent). Queen Mary also offers a £6,000 Global Talent Scholarship for slightly lower grades.
qmul-global-excellence-scholarship-pgt-2.eligibility: International fee-paying offer holders of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) for an eligible September 2027 PGT programme with a first-class degree or overseas equivalent.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible taught master's at Queen Mary
After receiving your offer, submit the Global Excellence Scholarship application
Awards are confirmed on a rolling basis until April 2027
qmul-global-excellence-scholarship-pgt-2.costs: £8,000 tuition fee reduction for the first year. Living costs not covered.

qmul-global-talent-scholarship-pgt-2027.about:
Queen Mary University of London's Global Talent Scholarship gives £6,000 towards tuition to international students holding an offer for an eligible postgraduate taught programme starting in September 2027. It sits alongside the £8,000 Global Excellence Scholarship, with a slightly lower academic threshold.

Awards are unlimited until April 2027 and allocated on a rolling basis, so apply as soon as you receive your offer.
qmul-global-talent-scholarship-pgt-2027.eligibility: International fee-paying offer holders (all nationalities incl. Georgia and Qatar) for an eligible Queen Mary PGT programme starting September 2027 meeting the grade criteria.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible PGT programme at Queen Mary
After your offer, submit the Global Talent Scholarship application
Decisions on a rolling basis

queens-belfast-international-undergradua.about:
Queen's University Belfast (Russell Group, Northern Ireland) awards an International Undergraduate Scholarship worth £3,500 or £4,000 (depending on the fee band) to new full-time international undergraduates, including those entering Year 2 or 3. It is applied automatically on enrolment.

It is open to students from Europe and Central Asia (including Georgia), the Middle East (including Qatar), Asia, Africa and the Americas; Irish students are excluded. New students with an unconditional offer who pay their first-year fees in full by the published deadline also get a £1,500 Early Confirmation Award.
highlights: Explicitly covers Georgia and Qatar regions
queens-belfast-international-undergradua.eligibility: New full-time international-fee undergraduates from any region outside Ireland (Georgia and Qatar included). Exclusions for some programmes apply.
how_to_apply: Apply to Queen's through UCAS.
Accept your offer and enrol.
The scholarship is applied automatically; for the Early Confirmation Award, pay fees in full and email proof by the deadline.
queens-belfast-international-undergradua.costs: £3,500 or £4,000 tuition reduction plus optional £1,500 early-payment discount.

reading-masters-excellence-scholarship-2.about:
The University of Reading automatically considers international fee-paying master's applicants for its Master's Excellence Scholarship. For 2027/28 entry, awards are tuition fee reductions of £4,000 to £10,000 depending on your academic achievement.

There is no form and no deadline: if you receive an offer and meet the grade thresholds, the reduction is added to your offer. Reading also hosts GREAT, Commonwealth and departmental scholarships that may be applied for separately.
reading-masters-excellence-scholarship-2.eligibility: International fee-paying students receiving an offer for an eligible 2027/28 master's at Reading with strong prior grades. All nationalities.
how_to_apply: Apply for a master's at Reading
Receive your offer; eligibility is checked automatically
Accept the offer with the scholarship applied

rgu-international-student-discount-under.about:
Robert Gordon University's International Student Discount gives any international self-funded fee-paying student a £2,000 discount on each year of undergraduate tuition, for a full-time on-campus course entering Year 1 in September.

All countries of residence are eligible. Students can only hold one RGU-funded scholarship per programme, so strong applicants should also consider the Vice-Chancellor's Undergraduate Scholarship.
rgu-international-student-discount-under.eligibility: International self-funded fee-paying students entering Year 1 of a full-time on-campus RGU undergraduate course in September.
how_to_apply: Apply to RGU for September entry.
Receive an offer and confirm self-funding status.
Follow the 'How to apply' steps on the discount page to claim it.
rgu-international-student-discount-under.costs: £2,000 discount per year of undergraduate tuition.

rgu-vice-chancellors-undergraduate-schol.about:
RGU's Vice-Chancellor's Undergraduate Scholarship covers the entire first-year tuition fee of any undergraduate degree for selected students entering Year 1 or Year 2 in September 2027.

Applicants must hold an offer for a full-time on-campus course, be classed as international or European fee payers, be self-funding and have met all offer conditions (except the deposit) by 1 June 2027. Students from every country, including Georgia and Qatar, are eligible. Only one RGU-funded scholarship per programme.
rgu-vice-chancellors-undergraduate-schol.eligibility: Self-funding international or EU fee payers with an offer for a full-time on-campus RGU undergraduate course (Year 1 or 2 entry), September 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply to RGU (UCAS or direct).
Meet your offer conditions by 1 June 2027.
Submit the Vice-Chancellor's Undergraduate Scholarship application before 1 June 2027.
rgu-vice-chancellors-undergraduate-schol.costs: 100% of the first year's tuition fee.

rice-financial-aid-international-2027.about:
Rice University in Houston offers need-based financial aid to international first-year students. International students who are admitted with aid receive 100% of their demonstrated need met with institutional grant aid (they are not part of the domestic Rice Investment programme).

Admission is need-aware for international applicants: your request for aid is considered alongside your application. Rice also automatically considers all admitted students for its limited merit scholarships.

Apply Early Decision I (1 Nov 2026), Early Decision II or Regular Decision (4 Jan 2027) and tick that you want aid. You then submit the CSS Profile (school code 6609), tax documents with English translations and the International Student Financial Statement.
highlights: 100% of demonstrated need met with grants
RD deadline 4 Jan 2027, aid documents 1 Feb
rice-financial-aid-international-2027.eligibility: Non-US citizens applying as first-year students. Must indicate the aid request on the admission application. International transfer applicants receive no aid.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App or Coalition by 4 Jan 2027 (RD) and indicate you are applying for aid
Complete the CSS Profile (code 6609)
Upload parent and student tax documents with official English translations in the applicant portal
Submit the International Student Financial Statement
Receive aid decision with your admission decision (RD around 1 April)
rice-financial-aid-international-2027.costs: Grant aid covering demonstrated need up to the full cost of attendance (tuition, fees, housing, food).

rmit-academic-merit-scholarships-interna.about:
RMIT University in central Melbourne is a large technology, design and business university. Its regional Academic Merit Scholarships give a 20% tuition fee reduction on eligible programmes: for Central Asia and Mongolia (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Mongolia) for the full qualification, for Southeast Asia (GPA 2.5/70%/ATAR 75 equivalent), for Africa and for Vietnam, plus a Future Leaders Scholarship for India and the subcontinent.

International students completing Australian Year 12 or the IB in Australia can instead receive the Medibank High Achiever International Scholarship (A$20,000) or Medibank Excellence Scholarship (A$12,000).
highlights: Central Asia, Southeast Asia and Africa schemes
rmit-academic-merit-scholarships-interna.eligibility: International students from the listed regions with strong results, or international students finishing Year 12/IB in Australia.
how_to_apply: Find your region's scholarship on RMIT's international scholarships page
Apply for an eligible RMIT programme for 2027
Follow the scholarship page's application or automatic-assessment instructions
rmit-academic-merit-scholarships-interna.costs: 20% tuition reduction (RMIT international tuition roughly A$38,000-48,000/year) or A$12,000-20,000.

rochester-merit-scholarships-internation.about:
The University of Rochester in upstate New York is a research university known for optics, music (Eastman School), engineering and its open curriculum. All admitted undergraduate applicants, including international students, are considered for merit scholarships with no extra documents; around 75% of admitted students for 2026-27 received one, averaging about US$20,000 a year, and named high-school awards range from US$10,000 to 35,000 a year.

Need-based aid is also available to a small number of international students (need-aware; CSS Profile code 2928, limited fee waivers until 15 Jan). To maximise merit consideration, submit your application and materials by the 1 Dec 2026 priority scholarship deadline; otherwise ED II and RD close on 5 Jan 2027.
highlights: ~75% of admitted students receive merit aid
Average award about US$20,000 a year
rochester-merit-scholarships-internation.eligibility: First-year applicants of any citizenship. Need-based aid for internationals is limited and need-aware.
how_to_apply: Submit the Common App or Coalition application by 1 Dec 2026 (priority) or 5 Jan 2027 (RD)
Send all materials by 1 Dec for highest scholarship consideration
For need-based aid, file the CSS Profile (code 2928)
Merit awards arrive with the admission decision
rochester-merit-scholarships-internation.costs: Merit scholarships typically US$10,000-35,000 a year against tuition of about US$68,000; need-based aid can add more for a few international students.

sabanci-university-graduate-scholarships.about:
Sabancı University in Istanbul, one of Türkiye's top research universities, grants nearly all students admitted to its academic graduate programmes (not professional programmes) a full tuition exemption; for 2026-27 the international tuition is US$24,500 a year. Most students also receive a monthly stipend, a free dorm room (or transport support) and private health insurance.

On 2026-27 rates, full-scholarship master's students receive 43,500 TL a month (10 months) and PhD students 67,500 TL (75,000 TL after the qualifying exam). Exceptional PhD applicants in engineering and natural sciences can receive the Distinguished Science & Technology Scholarship with 115,000–135,000 TL a month and international co-supervision. Scholarship decisions are made by the admission jury during evaluation.
highlights: Full tuition waiver for nearly all academic grad students
sabanci-university-graduate-scholarships.eligibility: Applicants of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) admitted to Sabancı's academic master's or PhD programmes; merit-based.
how_to_apply: Choose a programme in FENS, FASS or the School of Management
Apply online for Fall 2027 with transcripts, statement, references and English/GRE scores
Attend interview if invited
Scholarship offered with admission
sabanci-university-graduate-scholarships.costs: Full tuition waiver (US$24,500/year value); stipend 43,500 TL/month (master's) or 67,500–75,000 TL (PhD) on 2026-27 rates; dorm and private health insurance.

salford-global-gold-excellence-scholarsh.about:
The Global Gold Excellence Scholarship supports high-achieving international students at the University of Salford with £3,500 off tuition for every year of an undergraduate degree (from September 2026 entry onwards; £3,000 for master's).

You must be starting the first year of a full-time eligible undergraduate programme, hold an offer and achieve ABB at A level or the equivalent from your country (equivalents on Salford's country pages). Self-funded students progressing from Salford's International Foundation Year with 70+ also qualify. Any nationality is eligible.
salford-global-gold-excellence-scholarsh.eligibility: International students entering year 1 of an eligible full-time undergraduate programme with an offer and ABB at A level (or equivalent).
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Meet the ABB (or equivalent) requirement.
The scholarship is confirmed with your offer/enrolment.
salford-global-gold-excellence-scholarsh.costs: £3,500 tuition fee reduction per year of study.

sfu-international-undergraduate-scholars.about:
Simon Fraser University in Metro Vancouver offers its Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarships (USES) to high-school applicants with outstanding academics and extracurricular excellence. The international award is CA$140,000 (eight terms of CA$17,500), and in limited cases an extra CA$8,000 per term living allowance goes to exceptionally talented students with financial need.

You need an SFU application for the Fall 2027 term and a student number, a 90% average or 31 IB points in required courses, and two references. Apply by 15 Dec 2026; references and admission documents are due 31 Jan 2027, and winners are announced mid-March to May 2027.
sfu-international-undergraduate-scholars.eligibility: International high-school students graduating in 2027 (or 2026 without post-secondary study) with 90%+ or IB 31 in required courses.
how_to_apply: Apply to SFU for Fall 2027 to get a student number
Complete the USES application by 15 Dec 2026
Have two referees submit references by 31 Jan 2027
Complete all admission To-Do List items by 31 Jan 2027
sfu-international-undergraduate-scholars.costs: CA$17,500 per term for 8 terms; tuition roughly CA$40,000-45,000/year.

sheffield-international-postgraduate-sch.about:
The University of Sheffield, a Russell Group university, gives an International Postgraduate Scholarship of £7,000 off tuition to all self-funded overseas-fee offer holders on taught master's degrees starting in September 2027 who are permanent residents of (or have lived for three years in) India, Indonesia, Japan, Kenya, Nigeria, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, Türkiye, Vietnam or the USA.

There is no application: the award is automatic if you accept your offer before 4pm UK time on 6 July 2027. It cannot be combined with external sponsorship or other University discounts.
sheffield-international-postgraduate-sch.eligibility: Self-funded overseas-fee PGT offer holders resident in one of the listed countries for 3 years (Georgia and Qatar are not on the list).
how_to_apply: Apply for a taught master's at Sheffield
Accept your offer before 4pm UK time on 6 July 2027
The scholarship is applied automatically

sjtu-international-undergraduate-scholar.about:
Shanghai Jiao Tong University, one of China's top C9 universities, admits international undergraduates via the Common App. When you apply you can request the SJTU and Shanghai Government Scholarships, awarded for four years in three tiers: First-Class (full tuition waiver, living allowance of 2,500 RMB/month, accommodation subsidy of about 1,100 RMB/month and insurance), Second-Class (50% tuition, accommodation subsidy, insurance) and Third-Class (25% tuition, insurance). Results come with admission.

Tuition for 2027 is estimated at 150,000 CNY a year (English- and Chinese-taught programmes). Students can alternatively apply for the Chinese Government Scholarship through their local Chinese embassy, listing SJTU as first choice. Early Action closes 1 Nov 2026; the regular deadline is 31 Mar 2027.
highlights: Scholarship requested in the same application
sjtu-international-undergraduate-scholar.eligibility: International (non-Chinese citizen) applicants to SJTU bachelor's programmes with excellent academic records. Application fee US$75.
how_to_apply: Apply to SJTU via the Common App by 31 Mar 2027 (or Early Action 1 Nov 2026)
Complete the SJTU portal steps after preliminary review
Select 'Apply for scholarship' in the online form
Scholarship results are released with admission (by July 2027)
sjtu-international-undergraduate-scholar.costs: First-Class: tuition (150,000 CNY/yr) + 2,500 RMB/month + housing subsidy + insurance; Second: 50% tuition; Third: 25% tuition.
